en.lean_meat: The fresh-kill has gone scrawny and thin. All cats will need to eat more prey to survive.
en.forsaken: The stars have turned away. Leaders will only be given one life.
en.for_the_throne: Ambition rules. Deputies are more likely to murder the leader.
en.resolute: The deputy stands firm in their goals: duration before warrior focus can change is doubled.
en.fated_paths: Pawsteps are placed according to Silverpelt's design. Mates and ranks cannot be changed manually.
en.public_enemy: The other Clans do not welcome new neighbors. All Clans will start as hostile.
en.all_kittens: The Clan begins with only kittens. What left this group all alone in the world?
en.all_apprentices: The Clan begins with only apprentices. Young and alone, how will they grow?
en.all_elders: The Clan begins with only elders. How long will they last?
en.enmity: The other Clans view this Clan with suspicion and hostility. Clan relations will be locked to hostile.
en.stolen_vitality: To create something, something of equal value must be lost. When a leader is revived, a random Clanmate will die in their place.
en.survival_of_fittest: The strongest deserve the most. Feeding order is locked at Experienced First. Feeding priority is locked at Hunters. Selective manual feeding is disabled.
en.kit_season: The Clan's ranks are ever growing, perhaps more than is sustainable. Cats are more likely to have kits.
en.mouths_to_feed: Litters are likely to be larger. Will the Clan be able to provide for all its kits?
en.plague_ridden: Despite the efforts of the Clan, illness has made its home here. Disease and pest spread cannot be prevented by medicine cats.
en.one_cat: A single cat wanders the world, searching for fellowship. The Clan will begin with one member.
en.young_old: The ancient oak shelters a young sapling. The Clan will begin with one elder and one kitten.
en.barren_stocks: No one planned ahead. The Clan begins without any herbs or fresh-kill.
en.always_newleaf: The world always feels like it's just waking up into newleaf.
en.always_greenleaf: There's no escape from the sweltering heat of greenleaf.
en.always_leaf-fall: The leaves are perpetually the oranges and yellows of leaf-fall.
en.always_leaf-bare: The lack of resources that accompany leaf-bare never seem to relent.
en.underpopulated: Large litters are less common. How will the Clan continue with so few to carry it's legacy?
en.heartless: Survival makes no room for romance. Cats cannot take mates.
en.weak_stars: StarClan's power is faltering. New leaders will only recieve a random number of lives from 1 to 5.
en.clumsy_paws: The Clan is all paws and no grace. Skills and experience come slowly.
en.malicious_aura: Cats do not trust so easily. The Clan will permanently be seen as hostile by outsiders.
en.meagre_stocks: The Clan ran out of time to gather resources. Starting herb and prey stocks will be halved.
